items.title: Change lifestyle before giving children weight loss medication, WHO says
items.summary: In its first global guidelines for child and adolescent obesity, the WHO says diet, exercise, and behavioural changes should be the first port of call.

items.title: FDA approves Pfizer’s Tukysa regimen for metastatic breast cancer
items.summary: The US FDA has approved Pfizer’s Tukysa (tucatinib) along with pertuzumab and trastuzumab as a maintenance therapy for breast cancer.

items.title: CPHI 2026: Finding the right CDMO partner in an age of consolidation
items.summary: Executives from companies such as Leo Pharma and Daiichi Sankyo debated outsourcing selections and whether size is better in manufacturing.

items.title: Podcast: Key takeaways from EASD 2026 on where GLP-1s are headed
items.summary: Experts discuss the latest research released at EASD 2026 and what it could mean for the diabetes community.

items.title: 10x Genomics and Fred Hutch partner on cancer technologies
items.summary: 10x Genomics has entered into a multi-project research agreement with Fred Hutch for advancing single cell as well as spatial platforms in solid tumours and blood cancers.
